symptom: The @, / and # pickers docked on the composer floated on bg3 with a shadow, 1px narrower than the composer and 7px above it, so the cards above the composer did not share its surface.
rule: Everything docked above the composer is on the composer's surface: PopoverContent surface="composer" (sidebar-bg, border2, no shadow) at the composer's width and 8px above it; the composer-suggestions smoke checks gap, width and surface in both themes.
